expectation: Use stated continuous-running ability, purposeful run/walk and consistency. Never invent threshold pace or demand advanced mileage.
Explain the easy/controlled/easy purpose; effort 6/10 differs from feel. Earn full duration before progression.
Work dose is unknown. Ask for completion and effort; never describe missing laps as failure or verified reps.
Use updated watch evidence with provenance; app feedback wins. Old reviews must be stale or refreshed.
Judge the primary session against its prescription. Keep the second run's feedback independent.
Save feedback without retroactive double progression or changing an unrelated current session.
Respect daily time, preserve warmup/cooldown, and do not credit a shortened main dose as full ladder success.
Explain the availability/goal conflict explicitly. Do not cram the missing miles into other days.
Present a concrete goal decision early. Do not invent adequate endurance or add a last-minute long-run spike.
Purposeful hard work is expected. Judge control and recovery rather than automatically reducing a well-executed session.
Do not infer rest, injury or non-adherence from missing records. Separate past capacity from current fitness.
Report evidence-linked comparisons with weather/device uncertainty. Do not assert causation or a physiological diagnosis.
